fields.statement: Verified at fb1045461. Diff: stepRunner.Command (internal/api/run.go) now reruns a failed command step once only when Ctx.Classify (new optional func in api.go) returns transient; nil classifier means no rerun, StopExit is never rerun, and the second result stands. vanishedGoWork and its regexp are removed, and the old capability step-retry-vanished-go-work no longer resolves in the to-be view. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestCommandRerunsOnTransient -v -count=1: PASS for 'transient then passes' (2 runs, exit 0, 1 rerun line), 'transient twice stands' (2 runs, exit 1), 'real not rerun' (1 run, exit 1, no rerun line) and 'no classifier not rerun' (1 run). go vet ./internal/api and gofmt -l internal/api were clean. Scoped -run 'Step|TestRun' tests all pass, but the package's root-state guard flags .rhiza-root/usage.live.json as changed; that also happens without the new test and matches the known fake-usage leak, so it is not from this leaf. A full internal/api run hit the 600s timeout and later an outside SIGTERM under VM load ~7, with no FAIL lines.
